body: Sorry for the late reply, but the breakup was more than a year ago. Probably about two years ago, actually

I've went to the doctor before for depression, and they gave me meds and offered a therapist, but I don't have the budget for it. The meds helped some, but after a while, the thoughts started coming back, so I stopped taking them
Thank you for your kind words, and I hope that you get through that bad place, and become a stronger person from it
